title: Scene/tasks/sharing identical values + avatar eject
description: Template: jmap_server::check_read_only_patch / strip_read_only_patch (crate-jmap-server/src/helpers.rs) as used in mail (8a4d5b74 rewritten; git log --grep 'bd: JMAP-t8ej.25.1'). RFC 8620 §5.3: server-set properties MAY be in the patch if identical to the current value, else invalidProperties. Mark's decisions (on JMAP-t8ej.27 notes): {} and identical-only patches are a no-op success (updated {id:null}, no write, state unchanged); unknown-only patches and empty structural arrays stay errors. ORDER (lesson from t8ej.26): existence -> permission/closed-state/forbidden gates -> read-only check -> no-op exit. One test per handler, oracle the RFC/spec text. reject_read_only_patch(.., None) on update in jmap-scene-server asset.rs:460, jmap-tasks-server task.rs:383 and task_list.rs:323, jmap-sharing-server principal.rs:306: pass the stored object. Also scene avatar.rs: the owner/eject key check runs on the raw patch before strip_read_only_patch, so an owner/admin eject that repeats an identical server-set value ({leftAt, id:<same>}) is forbidden; compute the eject key set after dropping identical values while keeping non-owner changed values forbidden.
